<random position region: 22>
A
MGFaceset7
Hold on a second honey, let me just get
someone for your friend.
The bee girl whistles over another girl, who
flies down and picks up Mark's unconscious body.
You watch, defeated, as the two fly off deep
into the hive.
MGFaceset7
Hold on a second honey, let me just get
someone for your friend.
The bee girl whistles over another girl, who
flies down and picks up Alaru's unconscious body.
You watch, defeated, as the two fly off deep
into the hive.
MGFaceset7
Don't worry sweetie, everything will be
just fine.\..\.. Drink some honey and
everything will feel much nicer.
You're helpless to resist as the beautiful bee girl
shoves your face into her honey pot.
As the delicious nectar drips down your throat you
find the last fragments of your resistance slipping
away. Soon you mind is left a blank slate, waiting
to be written on.
The bee girl calmly leads you deeper into the hive.
As the smell of honey reaches your nose it becomes
your every thought and you begin to relax even more.
Eventually the bee girl brings you to a stop as
you reach a sparkling pool of golden honey and
she starts to speak once more.
MGFaceset7
Our hive needs more workers if we want
to survive much longer.\.
Please human, enter the pool.
Unable to resist the bee girl's sweet words, you
find yourself striding into the deep honey, until
you're completely submerged within the golden
liquid.
MGFaceset7
Don't worry, I'll be back later when
you're all done, okay?
As the bee girl flies off you find yourself
drifting away into a deep and peaceful sleep.
Bee3
When you finally awaken you find your body has
been melded by the sweet honey and that your mind
is filled only with thoughts of your hive and your
sisters.
As you slowly climb out of the golden pool, new
feelings erupt from parts of your body that never
existed before.
The fragile wings upon your back begin to flutter
as you shake off the last remnants of the honey,
and your human mind. Your entire body tingles
as thoughts of your new purpose enter your mind.
Bee4
The next years of your life are spent gathering
both honey and new sisters for your queen.
Bee228
You eventually even make a beautiful friendship
with a cute but clumsy handmaiden. Though her
silver hair makes strange memories pop up, memories
of humans and adventure...
Still those strange thoughts fade quickly once you
get back to work. Life in the hive is so very busy
after all, flying from one job to the next. You
always look forward to finding new sisters though...
Hornet03
You eventually even make a beautiful friendship
with a tenacious and powerful warrior. Though her
red eyes make strange memories pop up, memories
of humans and adventure...
Still those strange thoughts fade quickly once you
get back to work. Life in the hive is so very busy
after all, flying from one job to the next. You
always look forward to finding new sisters though...
Bee6
And while you can use your honey to bring in most
humans, some must be convinced in\..\..\..other ways.\.
Not that you're complaing of course.\..\..
